source: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Rainfall Classification Standards

classes.name: No Rain / Trace
classes.description: Trace or no precipitation. Soil remains largely unaffected.

classes.name: Light Rain
classes.description: 2.5 - 15.5 mm in 24 hours. Gentle moistening, beneficial for topsoil, low runoff risk.

classes.name: Moderate Rain
classes.description: 15.6 - 64.4 mm in 24 hours. Good soil recharge; potential pooling in poorly drained soils.

classes.name: Heavy Rain
classes.description: 64.5 - 115.5 mm in 24 hours. High waterlogging risk, runoff, lodging risk in tall crops.

classes.name: Very Heavy Rain
classes.description: 115.6 - 204.4 mm in 24 hours. Severe inundation, root asphyxiation, severe crop lodging.

classes.name: Extremely Heavy Rain
classes.description: Exceeding 204.4 mm in 24 hours. Catastrophic field flooding.
